sections.description: Embed elements from your connected platform — gift card designer and more — via shortcode, Elementor widget, or block. The plugin only places secure embeds; all checkout and payment flows run on the platform.
sections.changelog:
0.3.2

  • Brand logo across the gateway checkout, settings page and update screens.

0.3.0

  • WooCommerce payment gateway: appears under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments; checkout redirects to the platform's secure payment page; orders completed by signed platform webhooks. ILS carts, HPOS compatible.
  • Connection status indicator on Settings → WNC Pay.

0.2.0

  • Native WordPress updates via the public wncpay-update channel.

0.1.0

  • First release: settings page, embed core with auto-height and WPML-aware locale, Gift Card Designer as Elementor widget + shortcode + block.
